project_type: Node.js Express + Socket.IO multi-panel CRM (single-page apps served as HTML)
build_system: npm (no build step - just node server.js)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to verify dependencies. 2. Run node -e "require('./server.js')" with a timeout to verify server starts without error. 3. Verify syntax of modified HTML/JS files using node --check where possible.
environment_constraints: Internet access available for npm installs. No test framework. No Docker. Verification is limited to syntax checks and ensuring server starts.
contribution_requirements: No formal CONTRIBUTING.md. Code is inline HTML with embedded JS/CSS.
key_patterns: Each panel is a single HTML file with embedded <script> and <style>. Socket.IO is used for real-time communication. Admin joins 'admin-room'. TTS uses Google Translate proxy at /api/tts endpoint. Cross-PC TTS coordination via server-side turn lock (tts-request-turn, tts-turn-granted, tts-release-turn events). speakAnnouncement() queues text, splits into chunks, requests server turn lock, plays via Audio element with speechSynthesis fallback.
relevant_files: server.js (lines 2659-2700: TTS turn lock; lines 2687-2690: join-admin handler; lines 2819-2820: break events; lines 3854-3880: /api/tts proxy)
public/admin/index.html (lines 924-1014: socket.io setup, join-admin, event handlers; lines 2600-2618: end of file)

public/agent/index.html (lines 1291-1298: login announcement; lines 1441-1452: break start/end; lines 1502-1510: break warnings; lines 3118-3195: TTS infrastructure; lines 3218-3340: hourly review and scheduler)
